title: 第1614章 拜伦廉德臣服第1613章 空间黑洞长枪
content_zh:
他为了这些战备物资，才主动提议和默里·格林打一架。
结果自己被打了一顿，损失了自己多年积攒的威望，还要分一半物资给默里·格林，这让拜伦·廉德很是后悔。
可默里·格林却直接回道。
“呵呵，他们给你的战备物资，我全部要了。”
“并且你认输后，得赔偿我廉德群岛一半的资产，作为你对我冒犯的代价，并臣服于我，不然我就将第二根空间黑洞长枪投出了。”
“不可能，绝对不可能，我大不了当场认输。”
要是真这样办的话，他可就沦为南方诸岛的一大笑话了，所以当场拒绝。
“你觉得认输后，我就会停手吗？”
“什么？”
听到默里·格林这话，拜伦·廉德突然醒悟过来了一个道理，那就是强者才有话语权，弱者只有顺从。
所以强者制定规则，弱者遵守规则。
现在默里·格林是强者，而他拜伦·廉德是弱者，所以他就算不遵守约战规则，引发众怒也无所谓，因为他拥有践踏规则的实力。
拜伦·廉德其实早就知道这个道理，只不过他一直都是强者，所以用强者思维说话做事。
可遇到默里·格林后，他还没有意识到自己其实是弱者，才自认为自己拥有和默里·格林谈判的权利。
直到默里·格林说出这话后，他才忽然惊醒过来，意识到自己只是一名弱者。
一想到这个事实的拜伦·廉德，心里格外难受，没想到一直践踏他人的自己，竟然有一天会被他人践踏。
“考虑好没有，死还是臣服。”
说话间，第二根空间黑洞长枪凝结完毕，正对着还被吸附在黑洞上的拜伦·廉德，此时的他，正全力对抗空间黑洞传来的吸附力量，不让自己陷入未知虚空中。
如果再被一根空间黑洞长枪命中，那么他会瞬间被撕成两半，再也没有力量对抗空间黑洞的吞噬。
进入其中的他可能不会死，但却会消失在这个世界，所以这与死没有什么两样。

“我认输。”
在第二根空间黑洞长枪的威胁下，拜伦·廉德做出了最终决策，他满脸痛苦的闭上眼睛，大声喊出了这三个字。
与此同时，他也向默里·格林传音道。
“我臣服。”
“很好，你做出了明智的决定，好死不如赖活着，一个堂堂八级巅峰大强者，要是就这么死了，那可就太可惜了。”
回复了这句话后，默里·格林的元素领域快速收敛，最终凝聚成了默里·格林。
而第二根空间黑洞长枪，却如同达摩克利斯之剑一般，高高的悬挂在拜伦·廉德的头顶上，提醒他不要轻举妄动，不然就别怪他不客气。
content_en:
For these war supplies, he took the initiative to propose a fight with Murray Green.
As a result, he was beaten up, lost the prestige he had accumulated over the years, and had to give half of the supplies to Murray Green, which made Byron Lian very regretful.
But Murray Green replied directly.
"Haha, I want all the war supplies they gave you."
"And after you admit defeat, you must compensate me for half of the assets of the Liande Islands as the price for your offense against me, and surrender to me, otherwise I will throw the second space black hole spear."
"Impossible, absolutely impossible. The worst I can do is admit defeat on the spot."
If he really did this, he would become a big joke in the southern islands, so he refused on the spot.
"Do you think I will stop after admitting defeat?"
"What?"
Hearing Murray Green's words, Byron Liande suddenly realized a truth, that is, only the strong have the right to speak, and the weak can only obey.
So the strong make the rules and the weak follow the rules.
Now Murray Green is the strong one, and Byron Lian De is the weak one, so even if he doesn't abide by the rules of the fight and causes public outrage, it doesn't matter, because he has the strength to trample on the rules.
Byron Lian De has actually known this truth for a long time, but he has always been a strong man, so he speaks and acts with a strong mind.
But after meeting Murray Green, he didn't realize that he was actually the weak one, so he thought he had the right to negotiate with Murray Green.
It wasn't until Murray Green said this that he suddenly woke up and realized that he was just a weakling.
When Byron Liande thought of this fact, he felt particularly uncomfortable. He never thought that he who had always trampled on others would one day be trampled by others.
"Consider whether you should die or surrender."
While speaking, the second space black hole spear was condensed, facing Byron Liande who was still adsorbed on the black hole. At this time, he was trying his best to resist the adsorption force from the space black hole to prevent himself from falling into the unknown void.
If he is hit by a space black hole spear again, he will be torn in half instantly and will no longer have the strength to resist the swallowing of the space black hole.
He who enters it may not die, but he will disappear from this world, so it is no different from death.
"I surrender."
Under the threat of the second space black hole spear, Byron Lian De made the final decision. He closed his eyes with pain on his face and shouted these three words.
At the same time, he also sent a message to Murray Green.
"I surrender."
"Very good. You made a wise decision. It's better to die than to live. It would be a pity if a powerful eighth-level man died like this."
After replying to this sentence, Murray Green's elemental domain quickly converged, and finally condensed into Murray Green.
But the second space black hole spear, like the sword of Damocles, hung high above Byron Liande's head, reminding him not to act rashly, otherwise don't blame him for being rude.
